components.name: Main MCU
components.description: Central processing unit handling telematics logic, routing, and OS.

components.name: Cellular Modem (NAD)
components.description: 4G/5G modem for external communication with OEM cloud.

components.name: Hardware Security Module (HSM)
components.description: Dedicated hardware for isolated cryptographic keys and secure boot.

components.name: CAN Transceiver
components.description: Physical interface to the internal vehicle CAN bus.

components.name: External Flash Memory
components.description: Stores application firmware, configuration, logs and buffered telemetry.

components.name: SIM / eSIM
components.description: Subscriber identity used to authenticate the TCU to the cellular network.

components.name: Bluetooth/Wi-Fi Module
components.description: Short-range wireless link for in-vehicle pairing and workshop configuration.

interfaces.name: OTA & Telemetry Channel
interfaces.description: Cellular connection for Over-the-Air updates and telemetry data.

interfaces.name: Modem to MCU Bus
interfaces.description: Internal communication between cellular modem and main MCU.

interfaces.name: MCU to CAN
interfaces.description: Transmission of vehicle control commands and reading internal sensor data.

interfaces.name: Debug Port
interfaces.description: Hardware debug interface for development and diagnostics.

interfaces.name: OBD-II Diagnostics
interfaces.description: Diagnostic access for reading faults and reprogramming ECUs.

interfaces.name: GNSS Antenna Link
interfaces.description: Unauthenticated radio signals providing position and time.

interfaces.name: MCU to External Flash
interfaces.description: Reads and writes firmware, logs and buffered data.
